steps.content:
█ █, N.F. ██

One month after Zephyr's detention

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, I've completed archiving Sinner Zephyr's personal files and behavioral records. Please review them at your convenience.

You retrieve the files from Nightingale—noticeably thicker than when Zephyr was initially apprehended. The updated disciplinary reports are numerous, encompassing unauthorized absences, vandalism of public facilities, and various other infractions.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Zephyr has demonstrated strong resistance to Bureau regulations, persistently exhibiting defiant behavior. The higher-ups are particularly concerned about her recent attempted aircraft theft in Eastside and have requested a detailed investigation report from us regarding the incident.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Based on our assessment, the findings of this interrogation report are expected to influence the level of oversight required for Zephyr going forward. As for her... I'm afraid this interrogation won't be easy, Chief.
The records alone portray a clear image: someone as free-spirited and resistant to rules as her won't yield without a struggle.

Inside the interrogation room, Zephyr lounges casually on the chair's armrest, toying with a paper plane she crafted while waiting for your arrival. Yet the marks on her restraints tell a different story—clear signs of violent resistance.
Seeing your entrance, she retains her nonchalant demeanor. Though she straightens up slightly to face you, her posture still exudes informality.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Chief, how much longer are you going to keep me here...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: We just got a bit carried away that night and crossed some lines. Now that we're sober, can't we just pretend none of it happened?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Using special powers for signal interference, breaking into private property, attempting an aircraft theft, and operating without a license or registration... The Bureau can't simply "pretend none of it happened."

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: But none of it really put anyone else in harm's way, did it? Flying in the rain was a gamble I chose to make, and even if I had crashed, I'm confident in my abilities to steer clear of causing harm to others.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If this was indeed a spur-of-the-moment decision, we could consider categorizing it as an attempted theft.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: However, your actions were decisive and purposeful, with extensive knowledge of the aircraft's location and specs. All signs indicate premeditation on your part.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you still don't grasp the situation, let me break it down: Woods is a top private aircraft supplier in Eastside, and his aviation operations carry considerable weight within DisCity. Just this fact alone is enough for authorities to tag you as a threat to DisCity's air safety.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: In this verdict, except for the fact that my actions were "decisive and purposeful," isn't everything else just speculation?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You were there that day. You know it yourself—it really was just something that happened on a whim.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Now you're accusing me of "premeditation" after the fact? That's pretty sneaky.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Given what you did, proving the existence of premeditation is far more logical than proving its absence, isn't it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And your past record does little to alleviate your suspicion—"Escape from orphanage at age 8," "Instances of disrupting public order in Eastside," "Allegedly organizing events that incited civil unrest"...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your history will serve as perfect ammunition for others to scrutinize your every move. I doubt they'll be able—or even willing—to accept that you attempted this theft simply because it's a "spur-of-the-moment."

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: People always document my history based on their own thoughts of me. They didn't even bother to ask me before writing it. How can you be so sure that everything on it is accurate?
She presses her lips dismissively, showing utter indifference to the record of infractions laid out before her.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Why can't the story be like this? An eight-year-old girl broke free from her cage, encountered a series of adventures and hurdles, and voila! —Grew up into a brilliant, resilient adult.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That said, in your version, the story should continue like this: She suddenly decided to fly a plane on a rainy day and embarked on multiple daring adventures to reach her destination, only to fail in the final moments before dawn?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Mm-hmm, not bad! That's exactly the kind of story I like.
Her nonchalant, flippant tone show no sign of seriousness and your talk won't yield any useful results. Without confirming her motive for the theft, she will only face stricter surveillance measures.
You need to find an emotional trigger that will make her take the current situation seriously.
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, this free-spirited protagonist suddenly decided one day to turn over a new leaf, choosing to undergo the training and tests she despised most, all to become a pilot...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And then, coincidentally during her very first test flight, she caused the biggest route jamming ever in history. Miss Protagonist, isn't this all a bit too convenient even for a novel?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ...So this is how you talk into people?
Her smile freezes for a moment as her hands slowly clench into fists beneath her jacket sleeves.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Look, even if someone's done some wild things in the past—and sure, maybe not all of it was great—you can't just weave every little dot into some grand conspiracy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm simply stating the most logical and obvious speculation based on your records and current words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I were to put that story you just told as your motive in the investigation report, people who read it would jump to far worse assumptions about you than I have.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ...Such dirty minds you cops have! Why do you always have to assume the worst just because of some dumb record from the past, huh?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Did that damn file even tell you that I was one of the victims, too?!

Her sudden raised voice shatters the stillness of the interrogation room, leaving a resonant echo in its wake. Under your relentless questioning, Zephyr's chest heaves as a mix of anger and hurt finally bursts through her facade.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: On my very first flight ever, I was suddenly hit by that—that Mania or whatever it's called. Before I could even grasp what was going on, the control panel went haywire, and there I was, stuck in the cockpit, alone and helpless.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Sure, I love a good thrill, but I don't have a death wish, for crying out loud!
It was her very first flight. While the sky soared ever higher in the sunset's afterglow, she was plummeting towards earth.

In the cockpit, instrument needles spun wildly out of control. All contact with her fellow test pilots was lost. Warning lights flashed erratically in crimson, like a silent countdown to the demise of her own life.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Mayday, mayday... hah... (cough) Crashing on my first flight... bet there aren't many pilots who can claim that record.

The air pressure changed violently as her vision blurred in free fall... yet her senses were still pierced by the intense light from above. As she forced her eyes open to face the sun, she found herself with her back to DisCity, embracing the entire sky under the sun's blazing gaze.
To a pilot's ears, a crash always means absolute silence. Beep. In that perfect silence, the sound of reconnected signals pierced through.
She opened her eyes again amidst the pungent smell of disinfectant. The hospital room ceiling came into focus, along with her left leg suspended in traction.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: The test results are back. The doctor says that your leg injury will have some serious long-term effects, which means you are no longer suitable as a pilot. The incident has settled, and given your injuries, they've decided to arrange your discharge from service.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: I'm sorry. No one wanted this to happen. But, Zephyr... someone has to be responsible for this.
She stared at her leg, now held together with steel plates. It had only been her first flight.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I said, and I swear, if I hadn't struggled to restore contact with the control tower, everyone else up there would've been done for!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I wish someone had captured my heroic sacrifice for everyone's safety on camera. Even the Association never questioned me back then, so how did I end up being seen as some sort of dirty criminal?

The accident report indeed makes no mention of casualties from that incident. You thought it was just incomplete documentation, but now it seems more like a deliberate omission to shift responsibility.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you ever mention that you restored the signal connection? If that was verified, why would they still discharge you?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: They told me they admired my bravery, saying I was let go all because my leg injury made me fail the physical... but the truth is, after my power kicked in, I didn't even feel the injury anymore...
The official record explicitly states that Zephyr was discharged for disrupting air traffic protocols, but her testimony indicates the Association must have known the truth.
If Zephyr's account holds true, she is far from being the mastermind behind the signal disruption, but merely a victim of a Mania outbreak who even paid for it with one of her legs.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: So why do you people always jump to conclusions so carelessly? The minute you hear a story, you just slot people into your neat little categories without a second thought.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You're all the same—you, whoever wrote that file, that old coot at the orphanage, every single one of you! You're either painting me as a mastermind plotting some grand scheme or blaming my "troubled family history" for my "twisted personality."

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: My friends always say I'm an open book, wearing my heart on my sleeve, but everyone else just look past me, desperate to dig up some hidden trauma or ulterior motive.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: But I'm right here in front of you, aren't I? If you really want to get to know me, see me for who I am—just ask me!
Her loss of composure is a rare sight. Rather than dwelling on your earlier misunderstanding, she seems more concerned with your choice to be made at this very moment.

As you hold her gaze, you come to understand that her principles are even more straightforward than you'd imagined. Leading with this angle in the investigation report might help dispel others' doubts about the theft incident.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm sorry. It was careless of me to judge you based only on your files. I apologize for that.
Hearing your words, Zephyr freezes for a moment. Her gaze falls away from you briefly, only to return with a newfound sparkle.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ...Well, didn't expect that. I was mad at you for like three minutes, but you said sorry! So, cool, now the good vibes have swept away my anger. I'm starting to dig that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: While I still can't guarantee the inquiry will all go smooth, I'll try to hear your full explanation before drawing any conclusions. Would that work for you?
You remain composed under her scrutiny as she narrows her eyes, trying to read you for a few seconds before giving a decisive nod.
Having come to an understanding with Zephyr, you revisit her case file. She clearly showed lingering fear while recounting the crash, but why does she remain so enthusiastic about flying again?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: For something like this to happen, most people would probably steer clear of flying for a while, or even be traumatized just seeing a plane afterward. But you seem completely unfazed by what you've been through.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In fact, you still get quite excited when talking about flying again, like you did at the bar.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Cause if I don't fly again, my entire aviation career will end with nothing but an accident, a revoked license, and a broken leg.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I hate adventure stories that end mid-chapter.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: The sky is sooooo vast! It couldn't care less whether I'm scared or nervous when I reach for its embrace, and it definitely won't be asking for any permits when I try to get up close.
At the mention of flying, Zephyr's eyes light up instantly—just like that rainy night when you talked across your drinks.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You know what, I've been to the tallest building in Eastside, and let me tell you, when you gaze out from up there—all of DisCity lies tiny beneath your feet, like you could almost see past the Rust straight to Syndicate in just one glance.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: But when I'm up in the sky, even DisCity looks like a speck. The entire world just stretches out below, flat beneath my feet. It feels like I could go anywhere, reach any corner as long as I keep flying forward.
It was one dawn, before her first flight.

Zephyr and her friend snuck past security patrols to climb to the highest point in Eastside. As the horizon stretched out in the dawn light, she stood at the edge of the roof, her toes dangling over the precipice, watching the slumbering city beneath her in the refreshing breeze.
On an impulse, she spread her arms wide, drew in a deep breath, and shouted at the top of her lungs.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: —I, Zephyr, will fly a plane—! I WILL FLY—UP HIGH—

steps.speaker: Friends
steps.content: Hey, didn't you say your parents passed away in a travel flight? Seems like you've totally got it over.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Why does everyone have to live in fear of the past? I'd rather honor their memory by finishing the journey they never could.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I, Zephyr! Will never let fear keep me trapped!
That was one dawn before she had ever known flight. To her, reaching for that uncharted sky was an adventure—a symbol of absolute freedom.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: It was the same feeling when I decided to become a pilot, and the that night I tried to fly... I guess I just... love adventures where I can go anywhere, anytime, without anything holding me back.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Chief, can you see how I feel?
Unexamined judgments often lead to misunderstandings. But now, though you can't fully digest her words, you're starting to grasp why Zephyr pursues flying so relentlessly.

Her free-spirited upbringing shaped both her carefree nature and her unconventional expectations of society. That's why, after losing that freedom, she persistently rebels while searching for something to fill that void.
You realize this is also why she's been so completely honest with you about her past, including what drove her to attempt the theft.
—Because for what others see as life-changing decisions which require tremendous courage, Zephyr simply deems it as mere little adventures to be embarked upon without a second thought.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll classify the theft incident as a crime of impulse in the report, and I'll back up your statement with evidence of your personality and background.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If this report does dispel their doubts about you, I hope you will fulfill your obligations as a Sinner, from then on...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: So once their verdict comes in, I can leave this place, right?
She eagerly cuts off your sentence. Met with her hopeful gaze, you maintain your composure and firmly shake your head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Zephyr, you still have to remain under MBCC's supervision.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That's it? You should know, Mountain Lord, that I'm not convinced by your answer. The fatal wounds on the Scholar's chest were obviously claw marks left by a fierce beast.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Moreover, the main purpose of MBCC is to detain Sinners, and actions like your blatant appropriation of private property are exactly what warrants detention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All I can do for you right now is prevent others with ulterior motives from pinning additional charges on you.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I thought if I just explained everything, then...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Then tell me, what exactly do I have to do to get out of here?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't give you a definite answer right now. The parole process for Sinners involves multiple procedures. Not every Sinner is eligible for parole, and it will depend on the outcomes of your future evaluations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I can promise you this: I'll grant you as much freedom as my authority allows.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're interested, I can increase your participation in field missions or dispatch work. And of course, as long as circumstances allow, I'll do my best to secure short-term travel permits for you...
As you list out the flexible provisions in the Bureau's detention regulations, Zephyr's eyes glaze over with apparent disinterest.

Twirling a loose strand of hair around her finger, she maintains a heavy silence, her distant gaze fixed on you. The regret and yearning reflected in her eyes echo that rainy night when she was taken into custody.

After wrapping up the interrogation results, you escort Zephyr out of the interrogation room. Your footsteps echo in tandem down the hall, their steady rhythm only serving to amplify the unusual silence between you.
If Zephyr's boundless vitality that rainy night was unsettling, her current silence weighs on you just as heavily.
Suddenly, one set of footsteps drops out of the duet.

You turn around to find Zephyr standing before the glass door to the Activity Area. Today's simulated weather is sunny, and she stares at the artificial blue sky, her expression etched with profound melancholy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I promised you just now wasn't just talk. I'll work hard to secure your freedom here, but of course, it needs you to be cooperative too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're into adventures, there are some fun-loving Sinners here at the Bureau. You could be friends...

She turns to gaze at you, and though her eyes hold no judgment, your words somehow die in your throat. A strange distance hangs between you—physically shoulder to shoulder, yet emotionally as far apart as the sky above.
After a moment, she changes the subject on her own accord.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Do you know what my parents said during our family trip, on the day they passed away?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe... "have fun," "always be happy" or something?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I asked them where we were going.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Then Mom said, "I don't know. We've got a full ten days ahead. Let's just top up the tank and see how far it takes us. We're bound to find something before we need to refuel."

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Now I finally understand. Mom was right.

As the Outdoor Activity Area follows its programmed schedule to shift the sky view, the light gradually dims. The glass door before you slowly darkens into a mirror, reflecting your and Zephyr's silhouettes.
The silver door frame cuts between your reflections, as if dividing you and her into two separate, irreconcilable worlds.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You have to do all the fun things you want before the adventure ends. But it seems my own adventure will be just like my parents'—stuck halfway through, forever.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Zephyr?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Actually, I recognized who you were that night at the bar.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You were really terrible at disguising, you know.

Memories of that night surge from the depths of your mind—her playful taps on the glass, her pensive stares, and that frantic run through the rain when she dragged you along as if staking everything on that moment...
You freeze for a moment. Seemingly amused by your expression, her lips curl into a slight smile that never reaches her eyes.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I always knew I might be taken away after becoming a Sinner, but I never thought that day would come so soon.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: So, instead of saying, "I might as well go steal a plane today," what I truly thought that night was, "If I let this chance slip by, I may never fly again."
Just as abruptly as she brought up the topic, Zephyr drops it on her own accord again.

At her request, you spend some time with her in the Outdoor Activity Area, watching the sky together before escorting her back to the detention area. As you say goodbye, she waves at you with her usual smile.
You thought that Zephyr, like other new arrivals, would acclimate to life here gradually. However, within a month, reports surface of her growingly audacious escape attempts.
Only now do you truly realize that the understanding and connection you believed you had established with Zephyr during the interrogation might have been nothing more than your own wishful thinking.
On a rainy day, Zephyr disappeared.
